title: VoiceMailGreeting - Data API
description: Represents a custom greeting message that plays upon reaching a user’s voicemail. This object is available in API version 41.0 and later.

DurationInSeconds.description: The duration of the voicemail greeting message in seconds.

IsDefault.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
IsDefault.description: Whether the greeting is the user’s default greeting (true) or not (false).

MediaContentId.description: ID of the related content document.

Name.properties: Create, Filter, Group, idLookup, Sort, Update
Name.description: The name of the voicemail greeting message.

OwnerId.properties: Create, Defaulted on create, Filter, Group, Sort, Update
OwnerId.description: ID of the voicemail greeting message owner.

special_access_rules: As of Spring ’20 and later, only your Salesforce org's internal users can access this object.
associated_objects:
This object has the following associated objects. Unless noted, they are available in the same API version as this object.

- **VoiceMailGreetingOwnerSharingRule**: Sharing rules are available for the object.
- **VoiceMailGreetingShare**: Sharing is available for the object.
